about.bio: I am an architecture graduate from the Czech Technical University (CTU), holding both Bachelor's and Master's degrees. My background merges architectural design with hands-on, practical experience gained from developer and complex construction projects. I have an excellent command of the BIM-Revit environment, specifically at the detail design stage (DPS) level. Throughout my practice, I have proven my ability to handle independent design work, process complete project documentation, and effectively coordinate different professions.

Junior architect (2024-2025). I collaborated on the design and coordination of large development projects, focusing on layout modifications, common area design, and project documentation. I independently prepared and submitted complete documentation of the actual construction (DSPS). Additionally, I worked closely on preparing documents for authorities, gaining valuable insight into the processes and management of large-scale developments.
Work experience.Metrostav DIZ: Engineer (2022). I participated in the technically and historically demanding reconstruction of the Industrial Palace in Prague. I was responsible for the precise, on-site surveying of existing structures, opening fillings, and atypical wooden and metal elements. I then transformed these field measurements into the detailed drawing documentation required for further implementation phases.
Work experience.Epic Prague: Bartender (2021-present). Working in the extremely dynamic environment of a major Prague club has taught me perfect time management and exceptional stress resistance. I have learned to quickly and effectively resolve crisis situations under pressure while maintaining intensive, daily communication with diverse groups of people.

Graphics.My Path into architecture: My fascination with the built environment began early in childhood. It started playfully—building with Lego and designing virtual spaces in The Sims—but it quickly grew into a genuine passion. I have always had a natural affinity for buildings, constantly observing my surroundings to analyze what makes a space visually compelling and what falls short. This lifelong habit of observing and questioning naturally guided me toward architecture, where I can turn that curiosity into tangible design.
Graphics.My Values: In my architectural practice, I am deeply committed to the principles of sustainability and environmental consciousness. I firmly believe that exceptional design must seamlessly bridge aesthetic appeal with pure, everyday functionality. Visually and conceptually, I am highly inspired by the industrial style—I appreciate its raw honesty, structural clarity, and the way it can be adapted into modern, purposeful spaces.
Graphics.Looking For: I am currently seeking an opportunity where I can fully utilize my skills and find the right professional fit for my continued growth. Specifically, I am looking for a role that allows me to combine my strong architectural background with technical and process precision.

projects.title: Night club DEPOT
projects.description: For the Grid&Green Challenge at GreenHack 2025, we developed a web-based tool that helps urban planners, civil engineers, and grid design consultants find optimal power grid routes using a combination of remote sensing & GIS datasets like CORINE, ZABAGED, and Natura 2000. Our tool provides route visualisation algorithm optimised for cost, sustainability or other metrics selected by filtering options.
